question: Which African leader wrote the autobiography ‘ Long Walk to Freedom’?
solution:
The correct answer is **Nelson Mandela**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nelson Mandela** is the author of the autobiography 'Long Walk to Freedom'.
 
• The book chronicles his early life, coming of age, education, and 27 years in prison.
 
• It provides an in-depth look at his fight against apartheid in South Africa.
 
• The autobiography was first published in 1994, the year he became the President of South Africa.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Robert Mugabe
 Robert Mugabe was the former President of Zimbabwe, known for his controversial leadership.
 
 

 Nelson Mandela
 Nelson Mandela was the first black President of South Africa and a key figure in the fight against apartheid.
 
 

 Muammar Gaddafi
 Muammar Gaddafi was the Libyan revolutionary and political leader who ruled Libya for over four decades.
 
 

 Desmond Tutu
 Desmond Tutu was a South African Anglican bishop and social rights activist, known for his work in opposing apartheid.
